title: Occult Summoning Circle
description: A surreal dark fantasy scene shows a blue-robed wizard standing on a stone arch, casting a large glowing purple sigil circle containing an all-seeing flaming red eye. Below, a pale humanoid figure and a black horned demon with glowing red eyes stand within a stone and vine portal surrounded by white and blue flowers, skulls, and barren trees under a dramatic sky with Saturn and a winged emblem above.
prompt: Surreal dark fantasy painting of a blue hooded wizard standing atop an ornate stone arch, casting a massive glowing purple magical circle filled with runes, symbols, and a central flaming red all-seeing eye. Below the arch, a pale bald humanoid and a black silhouette demon with horns and red eyes stand together. Foreground features cracked stone, twisting vines, white and blue flowers, and skulls. Barren haunted trees and gothic ruins flank the scene under a dramatic sky with Saturn and a winged angelic emblem floating above, intricate linework, rich colors, mystical atmosphere.
